authorized_changes.scope: Create the reusable local-only database harness with incremental and clean-rebuild modes, exact five-category discovery, migration-manifest integration, fail-closed command allowlisting, compact ASCII evidence and no staging/production access.

Test mode selection, PostgreSQL-major parsing, mandatory category discovery, category-marker cardinality, local-only Supabase command restrictions, Windows-safe npm invocation, pg_prove summary parsing and stable package script exposure without requiring a remote project.
Create the self-contained pgTAP SCHEMA smoke suite that proves the local reconstructed database exposes required base schemas, auth.users and UUID support without relying on production data.
Create the self-contained pgTAP INTEGRITY harness fixture proving valid inserts plus CHECK, UNIQUE and foreign-key enforcement inside a transaction that rolls back.
Create the self-contained pgTAP RLS harness fixture with authenticated JWT context and both positive owned-row access and negative lateral-row denial; service_role is not used as proof of protection.
Create the self-contained pgTAP RPC harness fixture proving function existence, SECURITY INVOKER posture, explicit EXECUTE permission and contract result inside a rolled-back transaction.

Create the self-contained pgTAP MIGRATIONS suite proving local migration history exists and is non-empty, applied versions are unique and runtime PostgreSQL major matches the configured major 17 after reconstruction.
Add supabase:db:harness:test, supabase:db:test and supabase:db:test:clean as stable harness entry points while preserving the existing canonical npm test facade and all unrelated scripts.

Correct the historical local-replay blocker by replacing the nonexistent public.current_user_id() identity helper with the repository-canonical auth.uid() identity in exactly the two locations_validation RLS policy predicates; preserve all other migration semantics and statements.

Regenerate the canonical migration manifest after the authorized historical migration correction so its sha256 and byte count match repository-canonical LF content; do not alter unrelated migration rows or findings.
Record authorization, lifecycle transitions and consolidated evidence only for AUTH-DB-027::GLOBAL.

Reuse the verified AUTH-DB-015 migration inventory implementation to rebuild and check MIGRATION_MANIFEST.md after the authorized historical migration correction; do not modify the generator implementation.
Execute npm run quality:repair exactly once after complete materialization and before IMPLEMENTED; require REPAIR_SCOPE PASS and READY_FOR_VALIDATION SI without editing the repair implementation.
Use docs:implementation:start and docs:implementation:finish for the physical branch lifecycle; do not edit the lifecycle implementation.
